marque.non-telecharge: Not downloaded — available when the network returns

lien: Opens in the browser — network needed, nothing is kept on the phone

thematiques.aucune: None: this document covers all negotiations.

en-attente: No network: the download will start when it returns, even if the app has been closed.

issue.place: Not enough space on this phone: {taille} needs to be free.
issue.place-sans-taille: There is not enough space on this phone to keep this document.
issue.panne: The network dropped during the download. No partial copy is kept.
issue.refus: This document is no longer available, or your access does not cover it.

retirer.question: Remove this document from the phone?
retirer.phrase: It will no longer be readable offline. You can download it again.

favori.texte: Create an account or sign in to find this document in your favourites on all your devices. Downloading does not require one.
favori.connexion: I already have an account — Sign in

verrou.propos: The summary, themes and download are unlocked with the code shared in your WhatsApp or IFDD group.
verrou.reste-ouvert: No other document in the library is open to all. | The other document in the library stays open to all. | The {n} other documents in the library stay open to all.

vide.titre: This document is not in the library
vide.texte: It has been withdrawn, or the address is wrong.
vide.texte-hors-connexion: The list kept on this phone does not include it yet. It will show when the network returns.

erreur.titre: The library could not be loaded
erreur.texte: Nothing has been loaded on this phone yet. Check the network, then try again.

hors-connexion: This document can only be opened online, or once downloaded.
